rules: No parameter search, fitting or model calls. Each run starts with identical cash and empty inventory.
Full original engine versus current engine. Both use the SAME explicit fill transform, five-minute monitors and opening-event program analyses.
Fixed public ten-stock daily panel is NOT the uploaded Codex replay's dynamic universe or minute path.
Time splits are temporal validation, not pristine holdouts: this repository already used this panel in research.
Conservative daily scenario has zero inferred intraday depth. Cash preservation is not proof of alpha.
MA/breadth/ATR/volume use completed prior sessions; unknown industries are fully correlated with all sectors.
Cash and 75%-invested equal-weight buy-and-hold benchmarks use integer odd shares, scenario spread and minimum fees; terminal inventory is marked, not liquidated.
No annualized return for these short samples. No reliable odd-lot books, queue priority, corporate-action-adjusted total return or historical complete membership.
